text: On the published study page: (1) define 'in scope' (for an automatic merge) in the text and in the Glossary; (2) add a link near the top to the Athena repository as the next step; (3) rewrite the transitions lead-in sentence, and make each trigger name one decider only (for example t4); (4) explain why a merge (t10) leaves the state at Ready; (5) rewrite limits f2 and f3 in plain words a newcomer can follow. How much of the page should be about Athena itself rather than the studied system is a design question, so it stays a proposal and is not part of this request.
